reviews.author: Majimata
reviews.text:
A shopping mall that can be considered a mecca for Korean enthusiasts.
Because it is an old building, the structure is narrow and not very large, but there are shops selling nerd-related products on almost all floors.

Customers mainly visit Animate, which is located on a large scale on the top floor, and there are also various figure shops, pop-up stores, gacha shops, event rooms, and other things that creative art enthusiasts will enjoy.
In addition, there are restaurants, clothing stores, and paid exhibition halls where various exhibitions are constantly being held.
It's a fun place to visit regularly as new products and events are held regularly.
Be sure to visit if you are around Hongdae.

reviews.author: 王介柔律師
reviews.text:
I visited the Genshin Impact PC Lounge in Seoul on March 7, 2025. But this visit was the most terrifying experience I have ever had.

The merchandise area manager MBO (or BMO as he may be called) was a very racist person. I am from Taiwan and I fully understand that not all staff can speak Chinese. So I tried to ask a gift-related question in English.

However, this manager MBO pretended as if he didn't know English and refused to talk to me. When I tried to ask her a question, she just put on a fake smile and said "Yes" in a casual manner and then said nothing. Meanwhile, a Chinese male customer could speak Korean and confirmed the question for me, and only then did the manager MBO change his attitude and suddenly start answering me in English.

I strongly feel that this manager MBO clearly discriminated against me and insulted my character.
Why discriminate against customers just because they speak different languages? Isn't it a shame for Koreans to show such an inappropriate attitude toward foreign tourists?

I visited Seoul Genshin Impact pc lounge on 07 March 2025. I have to say it has been a super horrible experience I ever had.

The product area’s manager MBO (or maybe named BMO) is a very terrible racist. I am from Taiwan and it is understandable that not every staff can speak Chinese, so I use English to inquire some gifts question.

However, this manager MBO pretends like she doesn’t know the English and reject to talk to me while I trying to have the communication. She just stares at me with a fake smile, say yes with a frivolous and disdainful tone and then keep silence until the other male customer, who is Chinese and able to speak Korean, is willing to help me to confirm the question.

After they finished the conversation, the manager MBO suddenly changed her attitude and became able to speak English to me. I strongly consider this manager MBO actually subjected me to racial discrimination and insulting my personality.

Why could she treat customers distinctly just because of the speaking language. Such a shame as a Korean treat the foreign tourist in the so much inappropriate way.

reviews.text: It's a hidden gem for men, great for shopping Korean style clothing. You can experience Seoul’s latest fast fashion trends at an affordable price. The owner is friendly and although his English is not good, he will help you choose clothes to wear in Seoul. 😁

reviews.author: Fengfenggg gg
reviews.text: This store is like a hidden gem in Hongdae. While shopping in Hongdae during my trip to Seoul, I fell in love with the sewing machine in the window of this store, so I went in and it was really cool! The owner was so kind and patient in finding the perfect clothes for my friend and even helping with coordination, so my friend ended up wearing almost all of the clothes that the owner had made for her. There are a variety of clothes, and the owner’s sense of choosing clothes was really good! Thanks to you, I had a really enjoyable shopping experience!!! My friend keeps telling me that I must come back to this store the next time I come to Seoul.

reviews.author: laura xavier
reviews.text: This boutique specializes in men's clothing, and it's a really great place. Every piece in the collection has been carefully selected to reflect a genuine passion for fashion and an expert eye for the latest trends. You can find excellent quality clothes that offer both style and comfort. A warm welcome from friendly and helpful sales staff makes your shopping experience even more satisfying. If you are looking to enrich your closet with your own special items, I highly recommend you visit!

reviews.author: lillililli
reviews.text:
It's not 24 hours here anymore. Around 9 in the morning? to 12 p.m. and until 11:30 in the winter. A nearby 24-hour mart is Harmony Mart in front of Seogyo Garden, which is open 24 hours a day.

It has been renovated as a food mart, and bulk products are quite affordable. A 3.5 kg piece of king oyster mushroom was about 7,000 won, and a 10 kg piece of kimchi (made in China) was less than 10,000 won. In addition, large-capacity sauces are also quite cheap.

Overall, the price is not bad, but I don't feel like the quality is very good. (Especially the vegetables and fruits are a bit bad...but it's a bit better than before the renewal (probably when the owner changed);;)
